extdata.field.baseUrl.hint.invalid: It has to start with https:// (or http://). Paste it exactly as it appears in your provider’s documentation.
extdata.field.clientId.hint: Public identifier of the application you created at your provider. It is not secret.

extdata.field.host.hint: It has to be reachable from the internet: if the database is only visible from your office, this will not work.

extdata.field.path.hint: The part that comes after the API address. It starts with /.
extdata.field.rootPath: Where is the list inside the response?
extdata.field.rootPath.hint: Only if the API wraps the data in an object. Leave it empty and test: if what comes out is not a table, write the path here (for example data.items).
extdata.field.scope.hint: Optional. Ask only for READ permissions; separate them with spaces.
extdata.field.sql.hint: A single SELECT statement. It runs read-only: nothing you write here can change your database.
extdata.field.sql.hint.invalid: Only a read query is allowed: it has to start with SELECT (or WITH). Sytue never modifies your database.

extdata.field.sqlExample: SELECT id, name, total FROM sales ORDER BY total DESC

extdata.field.user.hint: Use a read-only one if you can. Sytue never runs anything that modifies data.
